concept: S3 Lifecycle: cascading storage classes to match access patterns
tests: Designing a chain of lifecycle transitions for declining access frequency, an instant-retrieval requirement and long retention.
expected: Standard for 30 days → Standard-IA for a year (instant access) → Glacier Deep Archive until 7 years. Triggers: "immediately retrievable" ⇒ IA/Instant, "almost never accessed", "kept for 7 years" ⇒ Deep Archive.
why_not: Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 30 days breaks instant access; deleting after a year violates 7-year retention; Intelligent-Tiering for 7 years costs more than Deep Archive for cold data.
